Instructions: Addieren Sie alle geraden Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle (Typ I) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks mit einer Inline-`COND`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce01 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 )
    ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR lv_num IN lt_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + COND #( WHEN lv_num MOD 2 = 0 THEN lv_num ELSE 0 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce03 IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_first_semi) = find(

        off = lv_first_semi + 1

    METHODS tokenize_string
      IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_abap_regex09 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tokenize_string.
    " Alle nicht-alphanumerischen Zeichen (außer Leerzeichen) durch einheitliches Trennzeichen '|' ersetzen
    DATA(lv_processed) = replace_regex(
      val = iv_input
      regex = `[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]`
      with = '|'
    ).

    SPLIT lv_processed AT '|' INTO TABLE rt_tokens.

    " Leere Token entfernen, die durch aufeinanderfolgende Trennzeichen entstehen können
    DELETE rt_tokens WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD calculate_transformed_sum.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ( 20 )

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce13 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item, value TYPE string, END OF ty_item,
           tt_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_group, key TYPE char1, values TYPE string_table, END OF ty_group,
           tt_hash TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_group WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS group_by_first_char
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hash) TYPE tt_hash.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_reduce13 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_first_char.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_standard(
      ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Apricot' ) ( 'Cherry' )
    ).

    rt_hash = REDUCE tt_hash(
      INIT groups = VALUE tt_hash( )
      FOR ls_item IN lt_items
      NEXT groups = VALUE tt_hash( groups
                      ( key = substring( ls_item-value, 0, 1 )
                        values = VALUE string_table( groups[ key = substring( ls_item-value, 0, 1 ) ]-values
                                                     ( ls_item-value ) ) )
                      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_split51 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD split_and_trim.
    DATA(lt_raw_segments) TYPE string_table.

      FOR lv_segment IN lt_raw_segments
